description: This is a shell script ('pr_cycle.sh') that manages the review lifecycle for components in a software project. The script handles operations like starting, stopping, and clearing review cycles by manipulating dates in 'metadata.yaml' files of components and updating related reports.

methods.name: list_components
methods.description: Lists all components by finding 'metadata.yaml' files and extracting their component paths, excluding certain directories.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays usage instructions and lists available components.

methods.name: resolve_metadata
methods.description: Resolves the path to a component's 'metadata.yaml' file; exits with error if not found.

methods.name: add_business_days
methods.description: Adds a specified number of business days to a given date.

methods.name: clear_dates
methods.description: Removes lifecycle date entries from a component's metadata file.

methods.name: regen_report
methods.description: Triggers regeneration of the RAG status report.
